budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Deliver all six individually owned ore blocks to their matching top-row depots while choosing between shared lift service and long edge ramps.
task.natural_termination: All six ore blocks have been delivered. There is no early loss terminal: depleted or unavailable lift service still leaves the physical edge ramps.
task.interaction: A socketed counterweight, simultaneous crank/brake, occupied destination and rope budget determine whether another worker and their physical cargo can travel; weight sale and owner-specific delivery rewards create competing uses.
task.observation_access: Fully observable. Every policy receives its role one-hot and all dynamic/game-relevant public state leaves listed by obs_keys, including the complete tile map, object status, carrier, owner, load mass, controls, platform, rope, depots and events. All active entities are visible to all roles; inactive consumed/delivered block coordinates remain in the public observation for accounting. Rendering uses the same state and cannot add information.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Platform moved one vertical cell during this step.
Ore delivered this step, indexed by owner.
Counterweights sold this step, indexed by owner.
A rope kit was consumed to restore rope this step.

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
